name: topomap_deployment_v1
task: navigation along a route of reference images from a prior traversal (prior traversal is an input; this is not single-goal-photograph navigation)

chain.spacing_basis: upstream create_topomap.py dt 1.0 s at 12 Hz; 0.2 m at the 0.2 m/s teacher

control_chain.kind: wrong-chain (cross-scene swap s_bend <-> junction, same run index)
control_chain.purpose: tests whether goal-region visits depend on the supplied route; route endpoints differ by 0.45 m between the swapped routes, so chance visits are possible and are reported, not assumed

localisation.inputs: distance head on camera history and chain images only; no pose, time or frame index

arrival: latched stop when closest_node == goal_node (final node = verified goal frame); chain progress logged per decision and never ends the episode

policy.context: six decision frames, 0.05 m apart at 0.1 m/s
policy.controller: reference_pd_twist dt 0.5 s + 120 Hz yaw-rate PI (qualification articulated-control-20261009-10)

measures: configs/eval/arrival_measures_v1.json (scored to the goal-image pose; navigation success reported only with the wrong-chain control row)
departures_from_upstream: upstream publishes reached_goal but keeps publishing waypoints; here reaching the goal node latches a zero command
chain built from a kinematic teacher traversal in simulation, not a teleoperated robot run
node spacing by frames of a 0.2 m/s traversal (0.2 m) rather than wall-clock dt of a teleoperated run
decisions at 2 Hz with 0.1 m/s (0.05 m context spacing) rather than 4 Hz at 0.2 m/s; same metric spacing
controller: reference PD map with dt 0.5 s plus a yaw-rate PI base loop; upstream uses its pd_controller at 4 Hz on a real base
preprocessing: training-style 4:3 aspect crop + resize; identical to upstream deployment's resize for 320x240 (4:3) frames
known_limitation: the yaw loop realises 0.52-0.78 of small commands (0.05-0.2 rad/s) within a 0.5 s hold; arms issuing different turn magnitudes are affected differently
stop_calibration: not part of this run; a separate threshold, if any, is chosen on calibration data, frozen, and tested on fresh episodes
